name: Saturn's Rings from Voyager 2, August 22, 1981, 16:51 UTC
blurb: Saturn's rings, made of billions of chunks of ice and rock. Seen by Voyager 2's wide-angle camera through orange, green, blue and violet filters: visible light only, 0.40 to 0.62 µm.
story: Saturn's Rings in sunlight, 3 days before Voyager 2's closest approach to Saturn on August 26, 1981. The ring particles range from tiny, dust-sized icy grains to chunks as big as a house.
